original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'MIMO' AND a.content CONTAINS 'codebook' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
